summary: Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of the sale of the 142-room Pier House Resort & Spa in Key West, Florida, to Last Mango Owner, LLC. The sale closed August 12, 2026, for $190.0 million in cash ($1.3 million per key), subject to prorations. Net proceeds were approximately $187.5 million after selling expenses, with about $93.7 million used to repay a mortgage loan. Including anticipated capex of $11.8 million, the price implies a 7.3% capitalization rate on trailing twelve-month NOI as of June 30, 2026. Pro forma financials were filed. Watch for capital redeployment and debt reduction benefits.
